CustomField.description: Org-wide maximum of admitted top-level instances for all definitions together (issue #136). When the count is at this value, a new start parks. The next watchdog sweep or a new start sends it to the gate when a slot is free. Blank, 0 or less: no ceiling. Children, starts with a parent, Continue-As-New successors and engine workflows take no new slot.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: A new start parks when this number of instances hold global slots. Blank, 0 or less: no ceiling.
CustomField.label: Global Max Active Instances
